It also reruns request-ID, notification, timeout/late response, disconnect and malformed-response scenarios. Evidence: /home/roomhacker/.codex/worktrees/herder-codex-native/agent-herder/.tmp/v052b-codex-profile-20261107/v053-isolation-smoke-green.log.
